mapper.sql: pi.id, pi.instance_code as code, pi.instance_name as name, pi.plugin_code as package_code, pi.plugin_name as package_name, pi.capability_code, pi.capability_name, pi.extension_point, pi.stage_code, pi.version, pi.entrypoint, pi.source_type, pi.order_no, pi.status, pi.timeout_ms, pi.plugin_type, pi.config_json, pi.is_deleted, pi.orphaned
mapper.select:
select
from kb_plugin_instances pi
and pi.is_deleted = 0
and ( pi.instance_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or pi.instance_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or pi.plugin_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or pi.capability_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
and pi.status = #{status}
and pi.plugin_type = #{pluginType}
order by pi.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into kb_plugin_instances( plugin_code, instance_code, instance_name, plugin_name, entrypoint, source_type, version, capability_code, capability_name, extension_point, stage_code, order_no, status, timeout_ms, concurrency_limit, plugin_type, is_deleted, orphaned ) values( #{packageCode}, #{code}, #{name}, #{packageName}, #{entrypoint}, #{sourceType}, #{version}, #{capabilityCode}, #{capabilityName}, #{extensionPoint}, #{stageCode}, #{orderNo}, #{status}, #{timeoutMs}, 0, #{pluginType}, 0, 0 )
mapper.select:
select
from kb_plugin_instances pi where pi.status = 1 and pi.is_deleted = 0 and pi.plugin_type = 'SYNC' and pi.extension_point = #{extensionPoint} and pi.stage_code = #{stageCode} order by pi.order_no asc, pi.id asc
